items.item: The page header has a plural title and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: h1 'Danh sách thiết bị' (equipment list); single primary button '+ Thêm thiết bị'; audit headerPrimaryActions=1; no export action at all.

items.item: The table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (such as location and status) and no row of KPI cards above it
items.evidence: Table is visible and has search #q plus status and area selects, but a row of four KPI cards (#kpis: Tổng thiết bị 14, Đang chạy 8, Sự cố / Dừng bảo trì 4, Kiểm định quá hạn / ≤14 ngày 3) sits above it and pushes the table top to y=263.

items.item: By default the list is ordered with overdue inspections first, then inspections due soon, then the rest
items.evidence: sortI=5, sortD=1 sorts by next inspection date ascending. First rows are EQ-0007 (28/10, overdue 8 days), EQ-0002 (overdue 3 days), EQ-0005 (in 7 days), then later dates.

items.item: Overdue and due-soon inspections are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 7 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: dueHtml() gives overdue rows the text 'quá hạn N ngày'. Due-soon rows (<=14 days) get the same 'còn N ngày' text as every other row, so they are distinguished only by amber colour and bold. Grey rows also read 'còn 15 ngày'.

items.item: Dates are absolute and consistently formatted, and every row has a human-readable equipment code
items.evidence: fmt = toLocaleDateString('vi-VN') gives d/M/yyyy everywhere (e.g. 28/10/2026, 10/6/2026), though not zero-padded. Codes EQ-0001..EQ-0014 are in the first column.

items.item: Status tabs or a summary line show counts (such as "Overdue 4")
items.evidence: There are no status tabs. The footer says '14 thiết bị - Trang 1/2'. The KPI card 'Kiểm định quá hạn / ≤14 ngày 3' merges overdue and due-soon into one number, and it is a KPI card, not a tab or summary line.

items.item: Rows are single-line, and row actions show at most two visible controls, with icon-only controls having accessible names
items.evidence: Audit: rows.double=8 and table-row-two-line is violated. The date cell stacks the date and a 'còn N ngày' line, with a median row height of 61px. There is no row-actions column or per-row control at all.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading state and an error state with retry are present
items.evidence: Only a plain row 'Không có thiết bị phù hợp' with no clear-filters action. There is no first-use empty state, no loading state and no error or retry state in the markup or script.

items.item: Interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: Audit smallTargets=0, so targets pass. But text-contrast has 6 errors: text-slate-400 'còn N ngày' at 2.56:1 and text-amber-600 at 3.19:1.

notes: Generic Tailwind admin look: slate-900 sidebar with a blue primary button, and a four-card KPI strip above the table. The green, amber, red and blue status pills are the rainbow-status tell. The table headers are all-caps, which the audit flagged under uppercase-text, but there is no letter-spacing. No gradient, glass, emoji, avatars, hover-lift or oversized radius. The app has a plain no-results row, but no clear-filters, loading or error state. Only two filters (status and area), which is acceptable. Audit score 82.
